verdict.summary: Round 2 resolves the prior major finding. delegate now constructs the complete parent scope and validates it with check_scope before either the inherited or selected branch path, so publicly mutated parents with out-of-order or duplicate branches, a primary-order violation, or shared topics cannot be used to mint a signed child. The new delegation_rejects_a_non_canonical_parent test exercises the real delegate path for both branches: None and branches: Some(...), first confirms the malformed parent is rejected by decode, and confirms canonical delegation still succeeds. The implementation preserves subset-only selection and canonicalizes selected children. No new correctness, soundness, test-validity, security, or instruction-injection issue is evident in the supplied diff.
